run_GTestFilterUnitTest: run the GTestFilterUnitTest class to verify Google Test filter and sharding behavior
test_SetEnvVar: test the SetEnvVar utility function to set or unset environment variables for subprocess tests
run_RunAndExtractTestList: run RunAndExtractTestList to execute a test binary and parse the list of tests that were run
test_InvokeWithModifiedEnv: test InvokeWithModifiedEnv to run a function with temporary environment variable overrides
run_RunWithSharding: run RunWithSharding to execute a test program shard and return exit code and tests run
